purpose: Provide an anonymous, lower-cost five-minute A-share candidate source without weakening the separately frozen licensed one-minute protocol.

forbidden_fields: current constituent label used outside its historical interval

observations: 2019 probe dates returned zero rows for 600000, 000001 and 300750
2020-01-02 and later sampled completed sessions returned 48 bars for the sampled listed symbols
the source timestamps are bar-end labels from 09:35 through 11:30 and 13:05 through 15:00
2026-07-10 returned 48 bars for all four representative symbols
on 2026-07-10 amount-to-local-daily ratios were within numerical precision of 1 and volume-to-raw_volume ratios were 100
on 2026-07-10 the maximum absolute raw OHLC relative error across the four symbols was 0.001757968
feasibility_probe_observed_before_contra.reason: The anonymous five-minute service returned no sampled 2019 rows, so it may not be represented as a 2019-start source.

timestamp_contract.missing_halted_or_duplicate_bar_policy: keep the whole stock-session ineligible; never fill, interpolate, deduplicate silently, or borrow another source
timestamp_contract.availability: after the completed trade-date close for next-local-session-open research only

limitations: BaoStock five-minute bars are aggregated OHLCV/amount, not one-minute bars, tick trades, order books, queues, or cancellations.
The sampled source begins later than the daily research history and can contain provider-level OHLC discrepancies within the frozen reconciliation tolerance.
The repository's current universe snapshot can introduce survivorship bias unless historical instrument intervals are enforced.
A full-market six-year snapshot is large and may take substantial disk space and request time; no bulk request is authorized by this contract alone.
